groups.summary: Business algorithms, contracts, adapters, and use-case composition.
Separately deployed conversion and native parser boundaries.
Explicit proof, evaluation, reconciliation, and experiment commands.
Agent skills for schema navigation, bounded reads, and ingestion.

routes.task: Change schema workspace, knowledge read, or ingestion

modules.summary: Fastify HTTP transport. createApiRuntime composes createVerificationHostRuntime before read runtimes.
interface: Versioned HTTP endpoints backed by application services. The shared verification host supplies ownership, admission, and the verification operation port; read, decision, and reconciliation runtimes stay API-local.
constraints: verification-ownership.ts is a thin Eve persistence adapter re-export of application ports. Do not treat API-local read or decision runtimes as the shared host.

modules.summary: Laptop transport: remote commands call KnowledgeClient over HTTP; local demo, attestation, and benchmark diff use application or verification on frozen files.
interface: Remote catalog requires API URL and token and dispatches through KnowledgeClient. Local commands stay outside the remote catalog and must not use HTTP.
constraints: Remote CLI must not import persistence or POSTGRES_URL. Do not fold local or mixed commands into dispatchCliCommand.

modules.summary: In-process Streamable HTTP MCP tools. createMcpRuntime composes createVerificationHostRuntime and VerificationOperationApplicationService.
interface: MCP catalog and tool handlers; not a second business-rule authority. Twelve verification mutations call VerificationOperationApplicationService.submit* after ownership and is*RequestAdmitted. knowledge_get_verification_operation, embedding.run_status, and promotion.status use operationService.get. retrieval.plan_validate is RetrievalPlanSchema.parse. Pipeline catalog writes still use operationService.submit.
constraints: Do not add new apiClient methods. New use cases go through application. Remaining HTTP shims: retrieval.search/explain/read_run/evidence packet/citation replay, evaluation.inspect_failures, vector_store.ingestion_status, provider reconciliation apply/get, most verification reads, and record-decision when isAdjudicationDecisionAdmitted is absent.

modules.summary: Sandbox verification executor that also hosts schema, bounded-read, and ingestion operations on CLI, MCP, and HTTP.
interface: knowledge-verify plus knowledge schema_*/db_*/ingest_*/artifact_get; one OperationDefinition feeds CLI, POST /knowledge/<name>, and MCP.
constraints: Distinct from apps/api's durable service transport; preserve the explicit sandbox capability model. Knowledge services are absent when no database URL is configured.
Agent claim/extraction intents select exact text quotes; native projection selector support in the library does not imply executor media admission.

modules.summary: Durable knowledge-operation execution, activity dispatch, and verification runtime wiring.
interface: Worker loop and activity registry; preserve lease ownership and idempotent terminal receipts.

modules.summary: HTTP and local-upload acquisition wired; inspect library for sealed bytes; repository, Firecrawl scrape, and paper execute remain unwired.
interface: Acquisition request/result types, routed HTTP/upload adapters, and sealed-byte inspection.

modules.summary: Composes knowledge use cases, capability admission, preparation, and verification surfaces, including ownership and transport admission ports.
interface: Application service facades and use-case functions; transports call these rather than implementing algorithms. verification-transport.ts owns ResolveVerificationContext, catalog/SQL admission factories, and the static context resolver. verification-ownership.ts owns the ownership resolver and read authorizer as application ports.
constraints: Transports compose these ports; they are not algorithm authority. Most verification and retrieval-evidence-eval read ports remain API-local.

modules.summary: Artifact conversion, immutable document nodes, admitted chunk profiles and reconstructable-span quality checks.
interface: convertStructuralDocument, normalizeDocumentText, createSourceLocator, reconstructNodeSpan, verifyNodeLocators, and the document-specific one-argument deterministicUuid; core retains its distinct two-argument helper.
ChunkProfileRegistry over CHUNK_PROFILE_TABLE (forSpace, forSpaceAndNodeKinds), chunkDocument, tokenize, reconstructChunk, validateChunks; ChunkProfile comes from contracts.
ConversionRouter (text → Docling → gated Unstructured), providers, HTTP clients, and SandboxedVerificationParser.

modules.summary: Out-of-process typed HTTP SDK for the Knowledge Services contract. Laptop CLI, Eve, Mission Control, and other repos. Not the long-term seam for API, MCP, or workers.
interface: KnowledgeClient methods plus public contract types. Callers construct HTTP; they do not import application.
constraints: Do not use from in-process KS servers except the remaining MCP HTTP shim.

modules.summary: Validates server, authentication, and semantic-provider configuration.
interface: Configuration loaders; do not read or emit environment secrets in docs.

modules.summary: Versioned Zod schemas and types shared by transports, application composition, and clients.
interface: Public request/result and verification contract schemas.

modules.summary: Pinned schema workspace navigation, bounded read snapshots and deterministic ingestion through canonical temporal helpers.
interface: loadWorkspace, searchWorkspace, getPage, compareHeads/assertHeadMatches, materializeScope; locate via SCHEMA_WORKSPACE_DIR or the pinned contract workspace/.
ReadExecutor.validateIntent/runIntent/sqlReadonly/explain/head; ArtifactLedger persist of intent+snapshot; assertSingleReadStatement admits one SELECT/WITH.
buildSpaceManifest is pure and generic in the space type; readSpaceManifest reads only the catalog queries that exist and records the rest in unavailable[].
IngestionExecutor.plan/apply/receipt; buildPlan; applyPlan inside temporal.begin_batch/assert_*/commit_batch; same idempotency key returns duplicateOf.
constraints: Consumes the committed workspace tree; it does not regenerate IR from the live database at request time.
Retrieval operations are skipped (RETRIEVAL_UNAVAILABLE). Named queries and artifact ops run.

space_manifest reports only its static half today: contract 0.4.16 has no space, store, version or publication catalog query, and no per-space budget exists at all. No executor operation is registered yet (Track K, after G3).
Writes orchestration.operation_intent/receipt; does not write a knowledge_service.operation row.

modules.summary: Shared identity, digest, authority and state primitives; artifact custody, operation lifecycle and in-memory telemetry.
interface: Small pure invariants and value helpers.
Artifact stores and ledger interfaces; in-memory implementations are not deployment authority.
InMemoryTelemetry and reconcileManifests; not a full external telemetry deployment.

modules.summary: Policy-scoped search, evidence-bound projections, embedding routes and receipts, and vector publication and rollback.
interface: Backend types, in-memory exact adapter, Postgres adapter, ExploratoryPublicationCoordinator (publish, rollback, reconcile), and the VectorItemEntityLink shape with validateVectorItemEntityLink.

The search submodule exports buildRetrievalPlan and retrieve; its plan, space-admission, lexical, semantic, graph and rerank stages remain internal. The package root also exports the preserved projection, embedding and vector-backend interfaces.
EmbeddingAdapter with discoverModel, embedOne, and embedMany; VercelAiGatewayEmbeddingAdapter and DeterministicFakeEmbeddingAdapter implement it; validateVector and vectorDigest bound output.
validateEvidenceSupport over EvidenceSupport, createProjection into the contract DomainProjection union, and classifyProjectionSpaces mapping dispositions to spaces.
constraints: src/vector-backends/spaces/link.ts is a shape only: no relational row binds a vector item to its projection target and admission in database contract 0.4.16. It has no caller until the S2 publication host.
Not on the canonical HTTP retrieval path: apps/api serves retrieval through packages/persistence. The search submodule backs the in-memory exploratory index and evaluation corpora.

modules.summary: Retrieval evaluations, benchmark statistics/comparisons, and human review structures.
interface: Evaluation cases and benchmark/review functions.

modules.summary: Postgres, storage, operation ledger, verification records, and runtime wiring adapters, including the shared verification host.
interface: Persistence implementations; schema migrations remain in the database-contract repository. createVerificationHostRuntime is the shared API/MCP host for ownership, catalog/SQL admission, and the verification operation port.
constraints: The host does not compose API-local decision, reconciliation, or verification/retrieval read runtimes.

modules.summary: Authorization, capability, retrieval, promotion, selection-eligibility, and verification admission decisions.
interface: Policy functions; successful execution alone does not authorize publication.
evaluateSelectionEligibility is a pure representation-eligibility read returning reasons, diversity group and per-space budget effect; it never enforces membership or budget.
constraints: Selection eligibility has no caller until S2; membership, budget and authority enforcement stays in packages/persistence/src/promotion-selection.ts.

modules.summary: Curated evaluation corpora, embedding bundles, retrieval fixtures, and operational test assets.
interface: Fixture loaders and test helpers; some bundle sources are sibling-repository inputs.

modules.summary: Evidence verification algorithms: canonical primitives, staged deterministic bundle engine, selector resolution, extraction, report gates, evidence-closed semantic judging, providers, and provenance seal/replay.
interface: Explicit named exports from src/index.ts consumed inside Knowledge Services; legacy prototype shapes via the ./prototype-compat subpath export; external callers use public service surfaces.

modules.summary: RFC 8785 canonical JSON and prefixed SHA-256 digests shared by every stage.
interface: canonicalizeJson, digestCanonicalJson, sha256Digest, isSha256Digest, ZERO_SHA256_DIGEST, prototype digest conversions.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.
Output participates in digests and signatures; never vary by deployment.

modules.summary: Exact rational-decimal parsing, replay, tolerance, and rounding.
interface: parseDecimal, replayDecimalOperation, compareFractions, withinTolerance, formatRoundedDecimal.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Staged mechanical bundle engine: index → capture integrity → runtime separation → evidence edges → assertions → metric graph → result.
interface: verifyDeterministicBundle(input, options) returns checks and semanticEligibility; check codes are registered in deterministic/checks.ts. Canonical JSON and decimal helpers moved to verification-canonical and verification-decimal.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Locates the evidence a VerificationSelector points at inside captured bytes: core text/JSON locators, projection-backed locators, and verification of resolver claims.
interface: resolveEvidenceSelector(request, resolvers?) is the single entry; undefined means no resolver owns the selector kind, a non-resolved status means the locate failed.
EvidenceSelectorResolver is the port for non-core kinds; projectionSelectorResolver dispatches to one parser+resolver per media kind under projections/.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.
Canonical projections require admitted acquisition/parser lineage; geometry and transcript selectors do not perform OCR or transcription.

modules.summary: Bounded schema admission and staged field, cross-field, and duplicate verification against immutable representation bytes.
interface: admitExtractionSchema, validateExtractionCandidate, verifyExtractionFields, verifyExtractionFieldsWithEvidence; comparators per FieldComparison kind in field-comparators.ts.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Audit-bundle seal/inspect/replay, recorded policy inputs, detached-seal benchmark publications, and DSSE/SLSA attestations.
interface: sealAuditBundle → inspectAuditBundle → replayAuditBundle over immutable lineage; replay.ts is the top of the package dependency graph.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Claim decomposition acceptance and report-wide mechanical gates.
interface: acceptClaimDecomposition, evaluateDecompositionProposal; verifyReportWide, verifyReportWideFromLedger, applyReportWideMechanicalGates (may only add failures).
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Source authority and corroboration assessments.
interface: assessSourceAuthority(assessments) returns an AuthorityDecision.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Evidence-closed semantic verification: closure, authorization, judge ports, output lattice validation, cross-family reconciliation, drift, rescue, attribution.
interface: verifyAssertionSemantics = mechanicalSemanticClosure → authorizeSemanticCase({ bundle, deterministicResult, assertionId, selectedFragments }) → verifySemanticCase; no reversal of deterministic failure.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Provider port, HTTP bounds, one bounded dispatch procedure, Gateway/Interfaze adapters, recorded/NLI judges, and conformance registry.
interface: dispatchBoundedCompletion enforces admission → persist request → fetch → persist response → interpret; adapters raise ProviderFailure with code and retryable flag and never retry.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Pinned Docling Serve conversion deployment boundary.
interface: Conversion HTTP service behind the TypeScript adapter.
constraints: Docling is not orchestration or publication authority.

modules.summary: Isolated native PDF geometry and HTML DOM parser; separate from Docling and OCR.
interface: Bounded stdin/stdout parser job invoked by SandboxedVerificationParser.
constraints: Selectors never start processes. Deployment configuration, not request input, selects the admitted image.

modules.summary: Targeted durability, transport, recovery, and integration proof executables.
interface: Explicit one-off proof scripts; inspect each script's prerequisites and effects before running.
constraints: Names such as prove do not imply read-only or offline behavior. This map never executes them.

modules.summary: Corpus/bundle evaluation and review sampling helpers.
interface: Evaluation scripts; distinguish deterministic fixtures from live provider evaluations.

modules.summary: Provider accounting and reconciliation operations.
interface: Operator scripts with explicit provider/database preconditions.
constraints: Do not treat these scripts as routine documentation-generation commands.

modules.summary: Curated model-card verification experiments; run results are not canonical architecture.
interface: Experiment-specific instructions and selected entry points; outputs stay excluded.

modules.summary: Progressive-disclosure procedure for navigating the pinned schema workspace without querying the database.
interface: schema-explore skill: knowledge schema search/get/manifest/materialize; MCP schema_* equivalents.
constraints: Does not query the database; use knowledge-db.

modules.summary: Procedure for catalog reads and reproducible knowledge-read snapshots that an ingestion intent can cite.
interface: knowledge-db skill: knowledge db head/read-intent/sql/explain and artifact get; MCP db_* / artifact_get.
constraints: Never writes; catalog queries are evidence, ad-hoc SQL is not.

modules.summary: Procedure for composing, planning, applying, and verifying knowledge-ingestion intents through the executor.
interface: knowledge-ingest skill: knowledge ingest plan/apply/receipt; MCP ingest_* / artifact_get.
constraints: The agent never writes SQL; the executor writes as executor_service.

modules.summary: Platform verification procedure with assertion/media routing, admitted operations, held outcomes and audit limits.
interface: Versioned platform CLI/MCP procedure; complete directory content participates in skill conformance and consumer pins.
constraints: Instructions describe public contracts; a seal or mechanical pass is not semantic admission.

modules.summary: Source discovery, acquisition, sealed-byte inspection and vetting-proposal procedure across executor and platform surfaces; a fetch, seal or inspection is never admission.
interface: knowledge-acquisition-and-vetting skill 1.2.0: executor source discover/import/attempt/reconcile/select, verify_capture_source/verify_capture_file, verify_read_capture/verify_search_capture; platform source discover/fetch/vet.
constraints: No source_resolve_identity operation; identity is resolved from captured bytes. Firecrawl/Tavily MCP stay in the agent environment and are imported as self-reported receipts.

modules.summary: Conversion route, node inspection, admitted chunk-profile preview, content linking, embedding and promotion-proposal procedure over already stored bytes; a routing receipt or chunk preview is not admission.
interface: knowledge-preparation-and-promotion skill 1.3.0: executor source_prepare_captured, content_link_plan/apply/receipt, content_summary_prepare; platform document convert/compare, chunk preview/build, promotion propose/review/status, embed run/verify/status; platform MCP equivalents.
constraints: Converts stored artifacts only and never fetches a URL; no session-local splitter; promotion_selection_select and promotion select are absent operations.

modules.summary: Scoped retrieval planning, search, per-stage explanation, immutable evidence-packet reads and citation replay through the platform CLI and MCP.
interface: knowledge-retrieval-and-evidence skill 1.1.0: platform retrieve plan/search/explain/run/packet/citations and operation status; MCP retrieval.plan_validate/search/explain_run/read_run/read_evidence_packet/replay_citations.
constraints: Context-only neighbors are never proof; revoked support is omitted or abstained; a retrieval result never becomes a publication decision.

modules.summary: Frozen-version evaluation procedure: reviewed retrieval cases, experiment runs, comparisons and failure diagnosis that recommend, never execute, a knowledge release.
interface: knowledge-evaluation skill 1.1.0: platform eval generate/run/compare/failures and benchmark compare/comparison; MCP evaluation.generate_query_candidates/run_experiment/compare_experiments/inspect_failures.
constraints: An evaluation report is a recommendation and evidence binding; it never switches an official pointer, revokes support, or weakens a failed hard gate.

modules.summary: Post-failure verification recovery: read the durable case, classify items by earliest failed stage, probe, plan, claim, execute, reconcile and checkpoint on the executor; adjudication through the platform CLI.
interface: knowledge-verification-recovery skill 1.0.0: executor recovery_* and checkpoint_* operations, verify_read_capture/verify_get_artifact/verify_register_artifact, report_assess, artifact_get; platform adjudication request/get.
constraints: Host configured (KNOWLEDGE_RECOVERY_CONFIG_JSON plus remote custody); never retries an unchanged input; recovery_close, recovery_cancel and recovery_admit are absent operations.

modules.summary: Store-class-explicit vector-store creation, document addition, evaluation, status, and guarded space publish/rollback submissions through the platform CLI.
interface: vector-store-management skill 1.1.0: platform store create/show/add-documents/evaluate/status, space publish/rollback, operation status/reconcile.
constraints: Submissions grant no activation or rollback authority; store search and space rebuild are absent; the platform MCP catalog has no publication or space activation tool.

modules.summary: Executor capture, quote, claim, extraction, policy and report procedure with a shipped offline CLI scaffold.
interface: Versioned executor CLI procedure; templates and references ship in the sandbox tarball and complete-content consumer pins.
constraints: Requires a matching executor build for optional comparison rules; host recovery governs production retries.

modules.summary: Package-private helpers: deep freeze, plain-record guards, and the allocation-bounded JSON walker shared by extraction, semantic, and provider preflights.
interface: Not exported from the package facade; callers keep their own error codes and byte-versus-character accounting.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.

modules.summary: Frozen legacy prototype locator, hash, JSON-pointer, arithmetic, and bundle translation shapes.
interface: Subpath export @aiengineer/knowledge-verification/prototype-compat; not on the root facade.
constraints: Internal verification seam; do not expose it as a cross-repository import contract.
Legacy behavior is frozen: no algorithm changes, no new callers.

modules.summary: Jev decision provider adapters, captured input snapshots, local SQLite queue and bounded OS worker processes.
interface: Private application implementation; public contracts are packages/contracts /jev. One supervisor per local database; at-least-once provider execution.
constraints: Single-host operator trust domain; no shared Supabase changes or distributed tenant guarantees.

modules.summary: Dedicated Jev HTTP/Streamable HTTP MCP and stdio host, plus HTTP CLI through the public client.
interface: jev serve/mcp-stdio; /v1/jev/jobs, batches, health and /mcp; jev_submit/batch/get/list/cancel/workers.
constraints: HTTP/MCP call application /jev; CLI uses KnowledgeJevClient. Dedicated service is user-authorized; broader ks CLI consolidation remains separate.

modules.summary: Agent procedure for closed-choice tasks, captured input references, process workers, uncertainty handling and LLM composition.
interface: jev CLI, HTTP/MCP job contracts, provider primitives and caller-orchestrated taxonomy/reranking recipes.
constraints: Research recommendations and historical results are not production calibration.
